name: Accessible High Contrast
designThesis: Uncompromising universal accessibility and perceptual clarity. Guarantees WCAG 2.2 AAA 7.0:1+ contrast across all states, tactile 3px keyboard focus indicators, dual visual cues (never color alone), and robust assistive tech compatibility.
bestFitContexts: Public sector and government civic portals
Regulated utility and banking service platforms

colorStrategy.canvasTone: Absolute pure canvas (#ffffff in light, #000000 in dark) with high-contrast structural borders
colorStrategy.accentUsage: High-contrast primary action (#0052cc / #004494 in light, #38bdf8 / #7dd3fc in dark); every state verified > 7:1
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Minimum 7.0:1 AAA across ALL text, badges, and icons without exception

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Highly legible humanist sans with distinct letterforms (Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Arial)
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: High optical weight distinction; minimum 16px body text; 1.6 line height; generous letter tracking
typographyStrategy.scaleFactor: 1.250 (Major Third) scale with responsive text resizing up to 200% without clipping

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: Clean, predictable single-column or 2-column linear layouts; unambiguous visual reading flow
layoutRhythm.whitespaceDiscipline: Wide touch targets (minimum 48×48px); generous margins separating clickable interactive elements

surfaceTreatment.radius: 2px to 4px slight rounding or crisp 0px corners for maximum border contrast
surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 2px solid high-contrast borders on all interactive inputs, cards, and buttons
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Flat high-contrast borders; zero diffuse drop shadows that blur edge definition

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: High-contrast solid button with 2px solid border, distinct text underline or icon, and 3px offset focus ring
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: High-contrast boxed containers with 2px borders, explicit headings, and clear separator rules
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Fully bordered data grid with bold headers, row numbers, and accessible table caption

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Unmistakable 3px solid focus indicator with 2px outer outline; full keyboard accessibility across all components; skip links
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: All animations disabled by default; instantaneous transitions only

antiPatterns: Light gray text (#888888 or #9ca3af) on white canvas
Relying on color alone to indicate error, warning, or success status
Focus rings set to outline: none or outline: 0 without replacement
Placeholder text inside inputs used as substitutes for permanent labels

browserChecks: Verify full keyboard navigation flow without mouse interaction
Verify 200% browser zoom reflow without text overlapping or horizontal scrolling
Verify Windows High Contrast / Forced Colors mode support
